exposure: Timing of cesarean delivery within the academic year (July/August vs. April/May)
outcome: Composite surgical complications (Hemorrhage, bladder injury, bowel injury, neonatal injury, cellulitis, wound complications, ICU admission, readmission)
cohort: Women undergoing cesarean delivery at 23 weeks' gestation or greater between 2012 and 2017
finding: Cesarean deliveries performed in the early months of the academic period were not associated with increased odds of surgical complications.
